mandate @ 0.3

module acme.system @ 0.1

interface AgentApi {
  protocol openapi
  spec     "docs/openapi.json"
}

interface CoreApi {
  protocol openapi
  spec     "docs/openapi.json"
}

interface CoreSchema {
  protocol db_schema
  spec     "src/main/resources/db/migration"
}

interface CustomerTools {
  protocol mcp_tools
  spec     "docs/mcp-tools.json"
}

interface SearchApi {
  protocol openapi
  spec     "docs/openapi.json"
}

interface TokenIssuance {
  protocol oauth
  spec     "docs/oauth-metadata.json"
}

component auth {
  repo     "acme/auth"
  root     "/work/acme-auth"
  lang     ts
  owner    role "identity_owner"
  build    exec("npm", ["ci", "--ignore-scripts"]), exec("npm", ["run", "build"])
  test     exec("npm", ["test"])
  provides TokenIssuance
}

component core {
  repo     "acme/core"
  root     "/work/acme-core"
  lang     java
  owner    role "core_owner"
  build    exec("mvn", ["-B", "-q", "-o", "-DskipTests", "package"])
  test     exec("mvn", ["-B", "-q", "-o", "test"])
  provides CoreApi, CoreSchema
  governance "deploy/**"
}

component evals {
  repo     "acme/voice-evals"
  root     "/work/acme-voice-evals"
  lang     py
  owner    role "agent_owner"
  test     exec("python", ["-m", "pytest", "-q"])
  consumes AgentApi
}

component mcp {
  repo     "acme/mcp"
  root     "/work/acme-mcp"
  lang     ts
  owner    role "support_platform_owner"
  build    exec("npm", ["ci", "--ignore-scripts"]), exec("npm", ["run", "build"])
  test     exec("npm", ["test"])
  provides CustomerTools
  consumes CoreApi, SearchApi, TokenIssuance
}

component search {
  repo     "acme/search"
  root     "/work/acme-search"
  lang     py
  owner    role "search_owner"
  test     exec("python", ["-m", "pytest", "-q"])
  provides SearchApi
}

component voice {
  repo     "acme/voice"
  root     "/work/acme-voice"
  lang     ts
  owner    role "agent_owner"
  build    exec("npm", ["ci", "--ignore-scripts"]), exec("npm", ["run", "build"])
  test     exec("npm", ["test"])
  provides AgentApi
  consumes CustomerTools, TokenIssuance
}

environment dev {
  class internal
  read shipment_status from core
    sql "select tracking_no, status, destination_city, delivery_date, delivery_status, attempts from v_shipment_overview where tracking_no = :tracking_no"
    params (tracking_no: Text)
    returns ShipmentStatusRow
    max_rows 1
}

environment prod_sim {
  class confidential
  read shipment_overview from core
    sql "select tracking_no, status, destination_city, delivery_date, delivery_status, attempts, full_name, phone, email from v_shipment_overview where tracking_no = :tracking_no"
    params (tracking_no: Text)
    returns ShipmentRow
    max_rows 1
  read shipment_events from core
    sql "select tracking_no, at, description from shipment_events where tracking_no = :tracking_no order by at"
    params (tracking_no: Text)
    returns EventRow
    max_rows 200
  read tickets_since from core
    sql "select ticket_id, tracking_no, category, status, channel, created_at from tickets where created_at >= cast(:since as timestamptz) order by created_at desc"
    params (since: Text)
    returns TicketRow
    max_rows 500
  read mcp_errors from mcp
    logs where (level == "error" or level == "warn") and ts >= since
    params (since: Text)
    returns LogLine
    max_rows 500
  read core_warnings from core
    logs where (level == "warn" or level == "error") and ts >= since
    params (since: Text)
    returns LogLine
    max_rows 500
  authorize deploy by human(role: "release_manager")
  authorize migrate by human(role: "db_owner")
}

environment staging {
  class internal
  read shipment_status from core
    sql "select tracking_no, status, destination_city, delivery_date, delivery_status, attempts from v_shipment_overview where tracking_no = :tracking_no"
    params (tracking_no: Text)
    returns ShipmentStatusRow
    max_rows 1
  authorize deploy by policy
  authorize migrate by policy
}

type CustomerName = Text classified confidential

type Email = Text classified confidential

type EventRow = { tracking_no: Text, at: Text, description: Text }

type LogLine = { ts: Text, level: Text, service: Text, msg: Text, tool: Text, status: Int, trace_id: Text }

type Phone = Text classified confidential

type ShipmentRow = { tracking_no: Text, status: Text, destination_city: Text, delivery_date: Text, delivery_status: Text, attempts: Int, full_name: CustomerName, phone: Phone, email: Email }

type ShipmentStatusRow = { tracking_no: Text, status: Text, destination_city: Text, delivery_date: Text, delivery_status: Text, attempts: Int }

type TicketRow = { ticket_id: Text, tracking_no: Text, category: Text, status: Text, channel: Text, created_at: Text }
